# U95: The way in: as Amara, rows pasted from a spreadsheet with “Goal name” and “Targett” as headers are read, Targett asked about once and read as Target, and saved; a CSV with a title row says its header is on row 2; a file with no Faro sheet says what headers it found and offers the template

- **Belongs to:** the Spreadsheets module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `BULK-IMPORT`, `IMPORT-LEVELS`
- **Budget:** at most 12 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `parity`, `logged` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/data/import` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U95

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/data/import` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Up to 30,000 rows a file, and 5,000 changes at a time.” is shown (else: Import does not say how many rows a file may have).
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “or paste rows from a spreadsheet” button is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Step.** Press the “or paste rows from a spreadsheet” button.
- **Check:** The “Paste rows from a spreadsheet” field shows.
- **Step.** Type “Goal name	Owner	Team	Unit	Start	Targett
Pasted cache hit rate	Rhea Kapoor	CI/CD	%	20	90
” into the “Paste rows from a spreadsheet” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Check these rows” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/data/import/check”.
- **Check:** “A column on Goals is called “Targett”. Read it as Target?” is shown (else: a header one letter out is not asked about).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “near header”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Read it as Target” choice.
- **Step.** Press the “Save 1 change” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/data/import/done/imp_”.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `!!g && g.plan && g.plan.target === 90 && g.ownerId === 'rhea'`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`; `const g = s.goals.find((x) => x.title === 'Pasted cache hit rate')`. Else it says: the pasted goal: {worked out in the journey as `JSON.stringify(g && { target: g.plan && g.plan.target, owner: g.ownerId })`}.
- _Note:_ A title row above the headers.
- Go to `/data/import` in the demo.
- Choose “titled.csv” to load in the “Choose a spreadsheet” field; the file is `csvFile('titled.csv', 'Platform goals FY27,,\nGoal,Owner,Team,Unit,Start,Target\nTitled cache size,Rhea Kapoor,CI/CD,GB,20,10\n')`.
- **Check:** “Row 2 of titled.csv is the header row; 1 row above it was skipped.” is shown (else: a title row above the headers is not said).
- **Check:** (`attention`) scored as met here.
- _Note:_ No Faro sheet: what was found, and the template.
- Go to `/data/import` in the demo.
- Choose “staff.csv” to load in the “Choose a spreadsheet” field; the file is `csvFile('staff.csv', 'Name,Department,Salary band\nAna,Ops,B\n')`.
- **Check:** “Its first sheet’s headers are Name, Department, Salary band…” is shown (else: a file with no Faro sheet does not say what it found).
- **Check:** (`errors`) the “Download the template” button in an alert is visible (else: the template is not offered beside the problem).
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
